sources.title: Public rights of way
sources.role: Active Travel England planning guidance on public rights of way and development.
sources.facts: Current guidance describes route classes, local-authority definitive maps and development considerations; it is not a parcel-specific legal search.
sources.guard: Public-rights-of-way, definitive-map, access-land, common-land and coast-path guidance or progress maps do not by themselves prove the exact legal route, unrestricted access, surface condition, accessibility, maintenance, diversion status, development compatibility or absence of unrecorded rights.

sources.title: Rights of way and accessing land – Overview
sources.role: Official public guidance on rights of way and open-access land.
sources.facts: The overview distinguishes public rights of way, open-access land, historic use and permissive access; each has different legal and factual requirements.
sources.guard: Public-rights-of-way, definitive-map, access-land, common-land and coast-path guidance or progress maps do not by themselves prove the exact legal route, unrestricted access, surface condition, accessibility, maintenance, diversion status, development compatibility or absence of unrecorded rights.
